reading: An original US first edition of Harper Lee's renowned novel, "To Kill a Mockingbird," was recently discovered within a donation to an Oxfam charity shop.
This significant literary find, the seminal 1960 work, emerged from a box of American books at the charity's Portobello Road bookshop in west London.
The valuable copy has since been acquired by the British Library, where it is destined to enrich its extensive national collection.
Olivia Haysman-Walker, the shop manager, identified this particular US first edition, noting its potential to have been easily overlooked.
She explained that despite the sheer volume of incoming donations, staff recognized the iconic novel and decided to scrutinize it more closely.
Oxfam personnel quickly discerned they were in possession of a truly exceptional item, recognizing its profound historical significance.
Although its dust jacket bore the marks of age and was somewhat worn around the edges, the internal pages remained in pristine condition.
Haysman-Walker expressed her amazement that such a valuable artifact journeyed from their bookshop into the prestigious British Library.
She characterized this as 'quite a journey' and a 'lovely reminder' during Second Hand September of the unsuspected treasures lurking in charitable donations.
Oxfam's annual Second Hand September initiative actively promotes the environmental and economic benefits of purchasing second-hand items.
Lee's Pulitzer Prize-winning book chronicles the lawyer Atticus Finch's valiant defense of Tom Robinson, a Black man wrongly accused of raping a white woman.
This profound narrative of societal injustice and childhood innocence, set in 1934 Alabama, has sold over 40 million copies globally and been translated into 40 languages.
The celebrated US novelist, a recipient of the Presidential Medal of Freedom, passed away in 2016 at the venerable age of 89.

vocabulary.definition: known and admired by many people for its quality or achievement; famous.
an object of historical or cultural interest, often valuable and discovered through careful investigation or circumstance.
certain or planned to add to the value, quality, or significance of something.
covering a large area; great in amount or scale.
the immense quantity or amount of something, emphasizing its largeness.
to examine or inspect something closely and thoroughly.
perceived or recognized something, often with difficulty, by using one's senses or intellect.
deep and far-reaching importance in relation to past events or developments.
in its original condition; unspoiled or spotless.
inspiring respect and admiration; having high status.
records a series of events in a factual and detailed way.
accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age, wisdom, or character.

entries.ja: その質の高さや功績によって多くの人に知られ、賞賛されている。有名な。
entries.ko: 그 품질이나 업적으로 인해 많은 사람들에게 알려지고 존경받는; 유명한.
entries.zh-Hans: 因其品质或成就而广为人知并受人钦佩；著名的。
entries.es: Conocido y admirado por muchas personas por su calidad o logros; famoso.
entries.pt-BR: Conhecido e admirado por muitas pessoas por sua qualidade ou realizações; famoso.

entries.ja: 歴史的または文化的に興味深い物で、しばしば価値があり、綿密な調査や状況によって発見される。
entries.ko: 역사적 또는 문화적 가치가 있는 물건으로, 종종 귀중하며 세심한 조사나 특정 상황을 통해 발견되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 具有历史或文化意义的物品，通常很有价值，通过仔细调查或特定情况被发现。
entries.es: Un objeto de interés histórico o cultural, a menudo valioso y descubierto a través de una investigación cuidadosa o por circunstancias.
entries.pt-BR: Um objeto de interesse histórico ou cultural, muitas vezes valioso e descoberto através de investigação cuidadosa ou por circunstância.

entries.ja: 何かの価値、品質、または重要性を高めることが確実であるか、計画されている。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 가치, 품질 또는 중요성을 더하게 될 것이 확실하거나 계획된.
entries.zh-Hans: 确定或计划好会增加某物的价值、质量或重要性。
entries.es: Cierto o planeado para añadir valor, calidad o significado a algo.
entries.pt-BR: Certo ou planejado para adicionar valor, qualidade ou significado a algo.

entries.ja: 広い範囲をカバーしている。量や規模が大きい。
entries.ko: 넓은 영역을 덮고 있는; 양이나 규모가 큰.
entries.zh-Hans: 覆盖范围广阔的；数量或规模巨大的。
entries.es: Que cubre una gran área; grande en cantidad o escala.
entries.pt-BR: Que cobre uma grande área; grande em quantidade ou escala.

entries.ja: 何かの膨大な量や数。その大きさを強調する。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 엄청난 양이나 수량을 강조하여 나타내는 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 某物巨大的数量或总数，强调其庞大。
entries.es: La inmensa cantidad o monto de algo, enfatizando su gran tamaño.
entries.pt-BR: A imensa quantidade ou montante de algo, enfatizando sua grandeza.

entries.ja: 何かを注意深く徹底的に調べる、または検査する。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 자세히 그리고 철저하게 조사하거나 검사하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 仔细而彻底地检查或审视某物。
entries.es: Examinar o inspeccionar algo de cerca y minuciosamente.
entries.pt-BR: Examinar ou inspecionar algo de perto e minuciosamente.

entries.ja: 五感や知性を使って、しばしば困難を伴いながら、何かを認識したり理解したりした。
entries.ko: 감각이나 지성을 사용하여, 종종 어려움을 겪으면서도, 어떤 것을 인지하거나 인식했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过感官或智力感知或识别某物，通常带有一定难度。
entries.es: Percibió o reconoció algo, a menudo con dificultad, usando sus sentidos o intelecto.
entries.pt-BR: Percebeu ou reconheceu algo, muitas vezes com dificuldade, usando os sentidos ou o intelecto.

entries.ja: 過去の出来事や発展に関連して、深く広範囲にわたる重要性。
entries.ko: 과거의 사건이나 발전에 관련하여 깊고 광범위한 중요성.
entries.zh-Hans: 与过去事件或发展相关的深刻而意义深远的重大性。
entries.es: Importancia profunda y de gran alcance en relación con eventos o desarrollos pasados.
entries.pt-BR: Importância profunda e de longo alcance em relação a eventos ou desenvolvimentos passados.

entries.ja: 元の状態にある。汚れていない、または汚れ一つない。
entries.ko: 원래의 상태 그대로; 손상되지 않았거나 얼룩 하나 없는.
entries.zh-Hans: 处于原始状态；未受损或一尘不染的。
entries.es: En su condición original; impoluto o sin manchar.
entries.pt-BR: Em sua condição original; intocado ou imaculado.

entries.ja: 尊敬と称賛の念を起こさせる。高い地位を持つ。
entries.ko: 존경과 감탄을 불러일으키는; 높은 위상을 지닌.
entries.zh-Hans: 令人尊敬和钦佩的；地位显赫的。
entries.es: Que inspira respeto y admiración; que tiene un alto estatus.
entries.pt-BR: Que inspira respeito e admiração; que tem alto status.

entries.ja: 一連の出来事を事実に基づき、詳細に記録する。
entries.ko: 일련의 사건을 사실에 입각하여 상세하게 기록하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以真实和详细的方式记录一系列事件。
entries.es: Registra una serie de eventos de manera fáctica y detallada.
entries.pt-BR: Registra uma série de eventos de forma factual e detalhada.

entries.ja: 特に年齢、知恵、または人柄のために、多大な尊敬を受けている。
entries.ko: 특히 나이, 지혜 또는 인품 때문에 많은 존경을 받는.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到高度尊重的，尤其因为年龄、智慧或品格。
entries.es: Al que se le concede gran respeto, especialmente por su edad, sabiduría o carácter.
entries.pt-BR: Ao qual se concede grande respeito, especialmente devido à idade, sabedoria ou caráter.
